mentions.h: THE MEN BEHIND THE TROPHIES — J. SAWYER
mentions.note: pictured with Harold King in a road race; programme lists an E. L. Reeves (possibly the same man, spelt differently)

photos.c: The photograph was taken in Denmark Road just before the start of the Club walking championship of 1923.
LEFT: Harold King (left), first winner of the "A.J. SAWYER" Cup, in action with E.L. Reeve during a road race.
